entities.summary: Antonio Lo Frasso was a Sardinian poet, writer and soldier. He was the author of Los diez libros de Fortuna de Amor, a work mentioned by Miguel de Cervantes in Don Quixote and edited in London by the lexicographer Pedro Pineda who considered valuable this work for his kindness, elegance and spirit.
